answer: Like a lotus pond, real growth spreads outward instead of piling into tight clumps. Each epoch the ledger runs community detection over the attestation graph: a vertex whose activity concentrates almost entirely inside one dense cluster is treated as a probable clone. To beat that, a sybil farmer must stage months of believable cross-community relationships for every identity - an attention and time bill no operator can parallelise away. Weight sinks to its nadir for flagged clusters while honestly scattered agents carry on untouched.
